verdict_msg: HARD_PASS: 3x-redundant reliability works -- averaging 3 noisy mirrored copies recovers recall>=0.95 vs single-copy 0.71 under corruption. Soft redundancy via wrapper (mirror+average), no core change. 3x=0.983 single=0.713
